## YTD Studio 1.1.0: watch and organize, not just download

**Which file do I need?**

| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| `…-1.1.0-setup.exe` | Windows installer |
| `YTD-Studio-1.1.0-arm64-v8a-release.apk` | Practically every Android phone. **Use this one.** |
| `YTD-Studio-1.1.0-armeabi-v7a-release.apk` | Old 32-bit Android phones |
| `YTD-Studio-1.1.0-x86_64-release.apk` | Android emulator / Chromebooks |

### Both apps
- **Download a whole playlist in one click.** It goes into its own folder, numbered in playlist order.
- **Keep playlists in sync.** Sync later downloads only the videos added since last time.
- **Playlists of your own:** create, rename, reorder, play all, shuffle.
- **Favorites**, watched / unwatched, and **Continue watching**: every video resumes where you left off.
- Player queue with autoplay, shuffle, repeat and playback speed.

### Windows
- New **Playlists** tab for downloaded, synced and your own playlists.
- Library: favorites and Unwatched filters, a Continue watching shelf, Play all / Shuffle, and a menu on every item.
- Player: an up-next list, fullscreen, and keyboard shortcuts (Space, J/L, N/P, F, M).

### Android (redesigned)
- New **Home**: one link bar (paste or share from YouTube) with **Watch now**, **Listen** or **Download**, then Continue watching, Recently added, Playlists and Favorites.
- **Library** with Videos (grid or list), Music, Playlists and Favorites tabs, search and sort.
- **Background playback** with lock-screen and notification controls, plus **picture-in-picture** for videos.
- Light, dark and system themes, and optional Material You colors.

> Android: if your previous APK was signed with a different key (see the README), uninstall it before installing this one.
